sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000010-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Silver Oak Medical Group 010 on April 2, 2026.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: an administrative fee of 2%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Pneumococcal share floor of 70%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
